sources.description: Iowa State has landed Fort Wayne (Ind.) North Side EDGE Leslie Woodson. Woodson was a great eval by the Cyclones as he was still under the radar recruiting wise but has explosive athletic qualities and big production from last season with 60 tackles (18 for loss) and eight sacks.
